exports.name: Calendar
exports.description:
A month grid for choosing a day or a range, with the locale's month and
weekday names (Intl.DateTimeFormat) and no date library. It follows the
WAI-ARIA date picker grid: one Tab stop; arrows move by day and week, Home
and End to the ends of the week, Page Up and Page Down by month (with Shift,
by year); Enter or Space chooses. Moving past the last month shown turns the
page. With `numberOfMonths`, two or three months sit side by side, each its
own grid, sharing the one Tab stop and the month buttons.

props.name: autoFocus
props.description: Focus the selected day (or today) when the calendar mounts.

props.name: defaultMonth
props.description: The month shown first; defaults to the selection, else today.

props.name: defaultSelected
props.type: Date | null | undefined | DateRange | null | undefined

props.name: disabled
props.description: Days that cannot be chosen (weekends, booked days). They stay focusable and say so.

props.name: labels
props.description: Names for the month buttons, for translation.

props.name: locale
props.description: BCP 47 tag for month and weekday names ("en-GB", "de"); the browser's by default.

props.name: max
props.description: Latest choosable day.

props.name: min
props.description: Earliest choosable day.

props.name: mode
props.description:
One day.
Two days and the span between: the first press sets the start, the second the end.

props.name: month
props.description: The month shown (any day in it). Controlled; pair with onMonthChange.

props.name: numberOfMonths
props.description:
How many months show side by side, 1 to 3. One pair of month buttons
turns them all a month at a time, and the keyboard moves across them.
Each month is about 270px wide: choose the count for the space.

props.name: onSelect
props.type: ((date: Date) => void) | undefined | ((range: DateRange) => void) | undefined

props.name: selected
props.type: Date | null | undefined | DateRange | null | undefined

props.name: showOutsideDays
props.description: Show the neighbouring months' days, dimmed, in the first and last rows.

props.name: today
props.description: "Today", for tests and server rendering; the current date by default.

props.name: weekStartsOn
props.description: First column of the week; the locale's own where known, else Sunday.

exports.name: CalendarLabels
exports.description: Strings the Calendar reads out, for translation.

props.name: at
props.description: Returns the item located at the specified index.

props.name: concat
props.description:
Combines two or more arrays.
This method returns a new array without modifying any existing arrays.

props.name: copyWithin
props.type: (target: number, start: number, end?: number) => Date[]
props.description:
Returns the this object after copying a section of the array identified by start and end
to the same array starting at position target

props.name: entries
props.description: Returns an iterable of key, value pairs for every entry in the array

props.name: every
props.type: { <S extends Date>(predicate: (value: Date, index: number, array: Date[]) => value is S, thisArg?: any): this is S[]; (predicate: (value: Date, index: number, array: Date[]) => unknown, thisArg?: any): boolean; }
props.description: Determines whether all the members of an array satisfy the specified test.

props.name: fill
props.type: (value: Date, start?: number, end?: number) => Date[]
props.description: Changes all array elements from `start` to `end` index to a static `value` and returns the modified array

props.name: filter
props.type: { <S extends Date>(predicate: (value: Date, index: number, array: Date[]) => value is S, thisArg?: any): S[]; (predicate: (value: Date, index: number, array: Date[]) => unknown, thisArg?: any): Date[]; }
props.description: Returns the elements of an array that meet the condition specified in a callback function.

props.name: find
props.type: { <S extends Date>(predicate: (value: Date, index: number, obj: Date[]) => value is S, thisArg?: any): S | undefined; (predicate: (value: Date, index: number, obj: Date[]) => unknown, thisArg?: any): Date | undefined; }
props.description:
Returns the value of the first element in the array where predicate is true, and undefined
otherwise.

props.name: findIndex
props.type: (predicate: (value: Date, index: number, obj: Date[]) => unknown, thisArg?: any) => number
props.description:
Returns the index of the first element in the array where predicate is true, and -1
otherwise.

props.name: flat
props.type: <A, D extends number = 1>(this: A, depth?: D | undefined) => FlatArray<A, D>[]
props.description:
Returns a new array with all sub-array elements concatenated into it recursively up to the
specified depth.

props.name: flatMap
props.type: <U, This = undefined>(callback: (this: This, value: Date, index: number, array: Date[]) => U | readonly U[], thisArg?: This | undefined) => U[]
props.description:
Calls a defined callback function on each element of an array. Then, flattens the result into
a new array.
This is identical to a map followed by flat with depth 1.

props.name: forEach
props.type: (callbackfn: (value: Date, index: number, array: Date[]) => void, thisArg?: any) => void
props.description: Performs the specified action for each element in an array.

props.name: includes
props.description: Determines whether an array includes a certain element, returning true or false as appropriate.

props.name: indexOf
props.description: Returns the index of the first occurrence of a value in an array, or -1 if it is not present.

props.name: join
props.description: Adds all the elements of an array into a string, separated by the specified separator string.

props.name: keys
props.description: Returns an iterable of keys in the array

props.name: lastIndexOf
props.description: Returns the index of the last occurrence of a specified value in an array, or -1 if it is not present.

props.name: length
props.description: Gets or sets the length of the array. This is a number one higher than the highest index in the array.

props.name: map
props.type: <U>(callbackfn: (value: Date, index: number, array: Date[]) => U, thisArg?: any) => U[]
props.description: Calls a defined callback function on each element of an array, and returns an array that contains the results.

props.name: pop
props.description:
Removes the last element from an array and returns it.
If the array is empty, undefined is returned and the array is not modified.

props.name: push
props.description: Appends new elements to the end of an array, and returns the new length of the array.

props.name: reduce
props.type: { (callbackfn: (previousValue: Date, currentValue: Date, currentIndex: number, array: Date[]) => Date): Date; (callbackfn: (previousValue: Date, currentValue: Date, currentIndex: number, array: Date[]) => Date, initialValue: Date): Date; <U>(callbackfn: (previousValue: U, currentValue: Date, currentIndex: number, array: Date[]) => U, initialValue: U): U; }
props.description: Calls the specified callback function for all the elements in an array. The return value of the callback function is the accumulated result, and is provided as an argument in the next call to the callback function.

props.name: reduceRight
props.type: { (callbackfn: (previousValue: Date, currentValue: Date, currentIndex: number, array: Date[]) => Date): Date; (callbackfn: (previousValue: Date, currentValue: Date, currentIndex: number, array: Date[]) => Date, initialValue: Date): Date; <U>(callbackfn: (previousValue: U, currentValue: Date, currentIndex: number, array: Date[]) => U, initialValue: U): U; }
props.description: Calls the specified callback function for all the elements in an array, in descending order. The return value of the callback function is the accumulated result, and is provided as an argument in the next call to the callback function.

props.name: reverse
props.description:
Reverses the elements in an array in place.
This method mutates the array and returns a reference to the same array.

props.name: shift
props.description:
Removes the first element from an array and returns it.
If the array is empty, undefined is returned and the array is not modified.

props.name: slice
props.description:
Returns a copy of a section of an array.
For both start and end, a negative index can be used to indicate an offset from the end of the array.
For example, -2 refers to the second to last element of the array.

props.name: some
props.type: (predicate: (value: Date, index: number, array: Date[]) => unknown, thisArg?: any) => boolean
props.description: Determines whether the specified callback function returns true for any element of an array.

props.name: sort
props.type: (compareFn?: ((a: Date, b: Date) => number) | undefined) => Date[]
props.description:
Sorts an array in place.
This method mutates the array and returns a reference to the same array.

props.name: splice
props.type: { (start: number, deleteCount?: number): Date[]; (start: number, deleteCount: number, ...items: Date[]): Date[]; }
props.description: Removes elements from an array and, if necessary, inserts new elements in their place, returning the deleted elements.

props.name: toLocaleString
props.type: () => string | { (): string; (locales: string | string[], options?: Intl.NumberFormatOptions & Intl.DateTimeFormatOptions): string; }
props.description:
Returns a date converted to a string using the current locale.
Returns a string representation of an array. The elements are converted to string using their toLocaleString methods.

props.name: toString
props.description:
Returns a string representation of a function.
Returns a string representation of an array.

props.name: unshift
props.description: Inserts new elements at the start of an array, and returns the new length of the array.

props.name: values
props.description: Returns an iterable of values in the array

exports.name: isSameDay
signatures: (a?: Date | null, b?: Date | null): boolean
exports.type: (a?: Date | null, b?: Date | null) => boolean

exports.name: localeWeekStart
exports.description: The locale's first day of the week, where the runtime knows it; else Sunday.

exports.name: toISODate
exports.description: The local day as YYYY-MM-DD, the form a native date input submits.

exports.name: Weekday
exports.description: 0 is Sunday, 1 Monday … 6 Saturday, as in `Date.getDay()`.
